fields.why: The headline '<1% of fully vaccinated persons' is '187 infections ... among 188,907 fully vaccinated persons ... a 0.1% infection rate', a population-denominator incidence, which supports count/rate (A). B's reading of it as a proportion under binary/categorical is defensible, since it is a cumulative risk expressed as a percentage.

The computed contrasts are ORs with 95% CIs (e.g. hospitalization OR = 0.2, genital rash OR = 2.3); percentages and medians are only set side by side with tests, and no difference or percentage-point contrast is computed, so 'both' is unsupported.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether a cumulative infection risk among a vaccinated population (cases/persons, reported as %) is count/rate or binary/categorical.
